summary.text: Brian Cole is a Republican state representative from Hillsborough 26 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Cole is a small business owner and the CEO of JC International, a wholesale tool company, according to Ballotpedia.

paragraphs.text: Brian Cole was born in Concord, New Hampshire, and lives in Manchester.
He graduated from Raymond High School in 1990 and earned an associate degree in accounting and a bachelor's degree in economics and finance from Southern New Hampshire University in 1995.

Cole has served on the Business Finance Authority Board, the Family Medical Leave Review Board, the NH Canadian Trade Council, the State Park Advisory Council and the Speaker's Steering Committee, and has been vice chair, chair and chair emeritus of the Manchester Republican Committee.
Cole lost the Hillsborough 14 general election on November 3, 2020, then won the Hillsborough 26 general elections on November 8, 2022 and November 5, 2024.
His 2023-2024 committee assignment was the Commerce and Consumer Affairs Committee.
